subject: Keeping demo environment live while PO clears
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medicore.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keep demo live while PO clears

Sergio —

Quick context: our finance team needs to route a PO through a vendor onboarding step that just hit an unexpected compliance queue. I expect the PO to clear in roughly 7–10 business days, but there’s a decent chance it slips a bit longer.

We’re right in the middle of a stakeholder demo and a short interruption would derail momentum. Would Redwood be able to temporarily extend our sandbox/demo access or provide a small token top-up so the environment stays live while our PO processes?

Attached is a scanned intent-to-purchase document from our procurement team (no official PO yet). I can also share a quick note from procurement explaining the delay if helpful.

We appreciate any runway you can provide — our goal is to finish the evaluation and sign once PO clears.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Products
Medicore Health

Attachments: PO-Intent.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medicore.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep demo live while PO clears

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the intent doc. We can absolutely help keep the evaluation active so you don’t lose momentum. I’m looping in Kim (sales ops) and Dev (finance liaison) to fast-track an interim support option.

Proposed short-term support:
- 7-day sandbox top-up: 75k tokens + 5 additional concurrent seats (to support the exec demo)
- If you need a longer runway, we can extend in 7-day increments pending a PO ETA

Next steps for us:
1) Kim — can you approve the 75k token bridge for Medicore under deal RDW-7893?
2) Liam — please confirm your best-case PO clearance date (so we can align extensions) and whether procurement needs a formal MSA/PO template from our side.

I’ve attached the internal approval stub we'll file for this temporary grant. Once Kim confirms, I’ll provision the tokens and send a short confirmation email with the exact sandbox expiry.

Sergio
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: redwood-bridge-approval.pdf (approval stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medicore.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep demo live while PO clears

On Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 10:05 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed short-term support:
> - 7-day sandbox top-up: 75k tokens + 5 additional concurrent seats

Approved.

Liam — we can provision the 75k token bridge and the extra seats today. Please confirm that you want the tokens applied to your existing org (Medicore Health) and whether we should set an automatic 7-day renewal pending PO confirmation.

Dev — flagging in case finance wants a notice on their side; otherwise Kim will create the credit record in the billing backlog.

Kim
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: (none)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medicore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep demo live while PO clears

Thanks Kim / Sergio — really appreciate the fast turnaround and the bridge credit. Please apply the tokens to the Medicore Health org.

PO status: procurement confirmed they will route the PO this week; expected clearance by 2027-05-10. If anything slips I’ll update immediately. An automatic 7-day renewal is fine — we’ll confirm or sign earlier if PO completes sooner.

I’ll also upload the procurement note to the Drive link Sergio shared.

Thanks again — this keeps the exec demo on schedule.

— Liam
Head of Data Products
Medicore Health
